what: Cut-out character stickers, stamps and tags wiggle endlessly in place — several types. swing: 2s ease-in-out, shakes 15° → −10° → 5° → −5° → 0 then pauses (every 20%). bounce: 1.8s, hops 30px at 40% and 15px at 60%, otherwise rests on the floor. wave: 10° ↔ −10° nodding linearly over 3s. poyo: 1.8s ease-out, squishes softly to .95x twice at 50% and 70%. fuwa: 2s ease-in-out, floats between −7° → (7px up · 0°) → 7° (alternate) — pyon: 2s, bouncy hops of 12px at 40~43%, 8px at 70%, 2px at 90% (animate.css bounce curve). step: 2s ease-in-out, marches in place from (−6px, −12px, −2°) → rest → (6px, −12px, 2°). yura: −5° ↔ 5° sway over 1.8s ease-in-out (alternate) — tick: over 5s goes −10° → (10%) −5° → (50%) 10° → (70%) 3° clicking over with no in-between values (step-end) (tick-2: −5·−5·6·3°, tick-3: −2·−3·1·2°). tick-jump: 9s, jerks up 30px at 10% and 95% and 50px at 40% (−3°), then drops straight back to the floor. tick-updown: 3s, every half beat it jerks up to (10%, −40%) then settles down — purun: swells 1 → 1.1x over .475s ease and shrinks back (alternate) · walk: 1.1s ease-in-out, 6px bobbing gait every half beat — koma-drift · koma-updown · koma-parachute · koma-ship · koma-gravity · koma-hop · koma-poke · koma-nudge · koma-sway · koma-swing: step between keyframes in just two steps with steps(2), jerky like a paper puppet show (cloud moves 10px at a time along a square path over 10s · 10px up and down over 5s · parachute 4s · ship 6s · 3s gravity hop 15·5px · 5s double hop 15·10px · cane 3s −5° · 4s 5px side-step · 5s sway −3/4/−2.5/3° · 3s ±8°). tip: 2.5s ease-in-out, tilts to −6° at 50% (axis label at the bottom right).

options.look: swing (default) · bounce · wave · poyo · fuwa · pyon · step · yura · tick · tick-2 · tick-3 · tick-jump · tick-updown · purun · walk · koma-drift · koma-updown · koma-parachute · koma-ship · koma-gravity · koma-hop · koma-poke · koma-nudge · koma-sway · koma-swing · tip · lean · katakata
options.--fx-dur: Length of one loop (CSS variable) — default is the value above per type. The original wave’s second type is 2s
options.--fx-delay: Start delay (CSS variable) — to stagger several, default 0
options.--fx-lift: bounce height (CSS variable), default 30px — a half bounce is half of that. pyon and step default to 12px (pyon settles to 2/3 and 1/6 of it, step goes sideways by half) · tick-jump defaults to 50px (small hop is .6x) · walk defaults to 6px · koma-drift one-frame width defaults to 10px (2x horizontally, .5x vertically) · koma-updown height defaults to 10px
options.--fx-rise: tick-updown lift height (CSS variable, % of its own height), default 40% — the slash beside the pointing staff member in the Brand hero is 60%·4s
options.look: rare-swing: Once every 20s, a slight sway 3° → −3° → 0 (during the first 3%), then stay still — Brand illustration. Pivot default bottom center
options.look: rare-pop: Once every 20s a bouncy 1.06 → .9 → 1.03 → .97 → 1 (over the first 5%) — Brand
options.look: rare-flip: Stays half-flipped left-right (rotateY 180) over 40s linear, then returns — Brand birds·people
options.--fx-step: Stop-motion style cell curve (CSS variable), default steps(2) — use ease-in-out for a smooth feel
options.--fx-angle: koma-poke tilt (default −5deg, opposite-side cane 5deg) · koma-swing width (default 8deg)
options.look: lean: A very slow sway pivoting on the bottom center: from --fx-from (default −8°) with the left side lifted by --fx-lift (default 8px) ↔ to --fx-to (default 5°) with the right side at .625 times that, swinging linearly over --fx-dur (default 30s) — brush strokes and branch clusters
options.look: sway: A flower sways about its stem end (bottom center) over 6s ease-in-out through 8° → −12° → 10° → −6° → 8° (rotate property). The paired flower uses --fx-way: reverse (animation-direction) · --fx-delay: .2s
options.look: katakata: Within a 6s ease-out loop, only the 21~28% span jolts by ±3° · 1px and the rest stays still — several are staggered with --fx-delay 2s · 4s (source site hero photo · smudge)
